{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = sales[
    (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
converted_count = filtered['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(filtered)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
